answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: The activation measurements match the fine-tuned range on nearly every feature. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.084 (fine-tuned 0.086–0.092). Layer 16 is 0.189 (0.162–0.194) and layer 32 is 0.414 (0.288–0.417). The final-layer jump is +0.117 (0.032–0.110), and cosine similarity is 0.906 (0.905–0.955). Effective rank is 3.12 (2.89–3.58), direction consistency is 0.705 (0.618–0.705), and the mid-layer size ratio is 1.021 (1.017–1.023), meaning the internal state grows. Quantized is ruled out because its size ratio is 0.968, its effective rank is about 4, and its layer-32 L2 is only about 0.25. System-prompted is ruled out because the layer-2 spike is 0.1 (it would be 31.7–64), layer-16 L2 is far below 0.37, and the size ratio is above 1. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
